role_contracts.normal_write_contract: CSI RPC, mount publication/registration, device/sysfs inspection, plugin bookkeeping and Ceph logs; not a book-file publisher. Exact source and command/spec profile required.
Actual PGDATA inside one exact node-local claim; postgres and its bootstrap controller share the same data claim.
Only the exact listed claim subvolume is mounted at the listed application workspace/config/cache/upload path. No books NFS source in the full Pod spec.
CNI binaries/config, BPF/cgroup state, network namespaces and network/kernel control state.
Device-plugin/CDI registration and NVIDIA MPS shared memory.
Containerd RPC, registry hosts configuration and /var/lib/spegel cache/state.
CNI binaries/config, CNI runtime/netns and kubelet network integration; host-root access is capability only and requires exact reviewed command/spec.
Actual --storage.path=/alertmanager inside one exact node-local claim.
Promtail position/checkpoint files under /run/promtail; source logs are read-only in these actual specs.
smartctl device inspection under /dev; no configured library publishing.
Ceph block/object/metadata service I/O and /var/lib/rook daemon state/log/crash/exporter files. Logical backing-store service; no configured book-path publication.
Device discovery under /dev; not book-path publishing.

boundary: Hidden unconfigured host bind aliases and arbitrary privileged writes are outside the reviewed normal configured publishing contract. No namespace or driver-wide exemption.
